Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Panale Sachin S.
 App for Respondent-State : Mr. R. V. Dasalkar

.....
 Coram : V. K. Jadhav, J.
Dated : 06th August, 2019

Per Court:-
 1.

The applicants in both the Bail Applications are seeking  regular bail in connection with Crime No. 197 of 2019 registered  with Pachod Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences  punishable under sections 188, 273, 328, read with 34 of IPC and  under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
 Their applications with similar prayer bearing Criminal Bail  Application Nos. 1440 of 2019 and 1363 of 2019, respectively Kashinath S/O. Baburao Hingale vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112598056/

 18-BA-921-2019+
 -2-  came to be rejected by the I/c. Additional Sessions Judge,
 Aurangabad.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants in both the Bail  Applications, so also the learned APP.

3. It appears that though the contraband articles came to be  seized from the Swift car in which both the applicants were  traveling, further detention of both the applicants in jail is uncalled  for.
Both the applicants are having permanent residence and they  are available for trial.
Practically, the investigation is almost over as  against them.
They are in jail since 22.06.2019.
So far as the  applicant Kashinath is concerned, he was merely driving the car  and the applicant Rohit has admitted before the authority that the  said contraband articles belong to him.
However, antecedents of  both the applicants are clear.
They are not likely to commit the  same offence in future.
I am thus inclined to release them on bail  with certain conditions.

Hence, the following order:
 ORDER I.
Both the applications are hereby allowed.

The applicant in Bail Application No. 921 of 2019, namely, KASHINATH S/O BABURAO HINGALE and the applicant in Bail Application No. 846 of 2019, namely, ROHIT S/O JAGANNATH DHARKAR be released on bail in connection with Crime No. 197 of 2019 registered with Pachod Police Station, District Aurangabad for the offences punishable under sections 188,
273, 328, read with 34 of IPC and under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, on Kashinath S/O. Baburao Hingale vs The State Of Maharashtra on 6 August, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112598056/
2 furnishing P.B. of Rs.20,000/- each with one solvent surety each of the like amount on the following conditions :-
a] The applicants shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner.
b] The applicants shall attend the concerned police station once in a week i.e. on every Sunday between 08.00 am to 11.00 am till filing of the charge sheet.
